countryMotifPolicy.flagMotifDecision: North Macedonia's current flag contains a secular stylized golden sun with eight broadening rays. Every scene uses a large complete nonliteral eight-ray sun fashion adaptation on at least two outfits without reproducing a literal flag.
countryMotifPolicy.palette: Flag red and golden yellow expanded with Lake Ohrid blue, pearl white, Matka emerald, Vardar stone silver, copper, and roasted-pepper crimson.
secondaryMotifs: Skopje Stone Bridge arches, Kale Fortress crenellations, and Vardar River ripples
Lake Ohrid wave fans, Samuil Fortress towers, and Ohrid pearl circles
Matka Canyon contours, kayak strokes, limestone facets, and Ramonda flower geometry
Bitola Clock Tower faces, Sirok Sokak facades, red-pepper strings, ajvar jar curves, and polished copper trays
countryMotifPolicy.minimumCoverage: Every scene places a large complete eight-ray sun adaptation across at least two outfits as a full bodice, skirt, hip, or panel field, with additional secular country motifs integrated at large readable scale.
countryMotifPolicy.cultureScene: Scene 1179 foregrounds Bitola's pedestrian culture through the Clock Tower and Sirok Sokak facade rhythm, with abundant red-pepper strings, ajvar jars, and polished copper service pieces as unmistakable secular food-and-craft culture.
countryMotifPolicy.prohibitions: No literal flag, no former Vergina Sun, official emblem, sacred symbol, political insignia, copied folk costume, badge, branded product, or religious architecture as the fashion motif.
